headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty supported by banking and IT stocks amid global AI sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Sensex and Nifty reached 9-month highs supported by record FII buying.
Global sell-off in AI stocks weighed on market sentiment during recent sessions.
Cues regarding potential US Fed rate hikes created early trade caution.
Banking and IT stocks helped drive market recovery in recent sessions.
whatHappening: Tata Steel announced a ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes for two units.
Federation of Indian Pilots raised concerns to the Civil Aviation Minister regarding the SpiceJet crisis.
Shree Cement announced plans to cross 100 MT capacity within 3-4 years.
PNB MD stated ECL provision requirement of around ₹5,000 crore will have no impact on profitability.
summary: The Indian stock market extended its 4-week rally to 9-month highs driven by strong FII inflows. Recent trading sessions saw volatility from global AI sell-offs and Fed rate hike cues, offset by recovery in banking and IT stocks. Major corporate news included Tata Steel's ₹28,000 crore deal and Shree Cement's expansion plans.
